description: The STORIX 32GB Ultra MicroSD Card is the high-performance choice for digital image capture and storage. Rated UHS-I Class 10 with speeds of up to 150MB/s, this card ensures swift data transfers and seamless Full HD video recording without any lag or interruption. Whether you are expanding storage on your Android smartphone, tablet, CCTV camera, or other compatible devices, this microSD card delivers reliable and consistent performance every time. Built to withstand the demands of everyday use, it is water resistant, temperature resistant, shock proof, and X-ray proof, making it a dependable companion in all conditions. The compact design fits effortlessly into any microSD-compatible slot, while the generous 32GB capacity gives you ample space to store photos, videos, apps, and more. Backed by a 5-year warranty, the STORIX 32GB MicroSD Card is a trustworthy storage solution for both personal and professional use.
